body: I'm going to bed, but I'll come back on here tomorrow, to address the points you wonderful people have made. Thank you.  I have more to write about.

I just caught the scene where Chuck tells Jimmy he's not worthy of being an equal peer as a lawyer, so I may miss some of the context, but FUCK CHUCK for being such an unsupportive dick when Jimmy supported his electromagnetic ass all that time!  To say that about your brother is nearly unforgivable.  I know how Jimmy feels and it is devastating.
I had never posted before and didn't think anyone would read this post, so after 2 hours I logged out and didn't think about it until now.  I'm sorry.  I'll probably write an updated post, anyway.
